coreAttributes.name: maid's high heel
coreAttributes.description: A pair of stylised, maid-themed high heels. They're made of coloured leather and sport a small amount of decorative lace.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] unbuckle [npc.her] heels and slip them off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] unbuckle [npc2.namePos] heels and slip them off.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly unbuckle [npc2.namePos] heels and slip them off.
